test_astype_single_dtype: test DataFrame.astype with a single dtype to verify copy-on-write memory sharing between original and converted columns
test_astype_avoids_copy: test DataFrame.astype avoids copying when converting between compatible integer dtypes including pyarrow-backed types
test_astype_different_target_dtype: test DataFrame.astype creates a copy when converting from int64 to a different target dtype with copy-on-write semantics
test_astype_numpy_to_ea: test Series.astype converts numpy integer dtype to pandas nullable Int64 extension array with shared memory
test_astype_string_and_object: test DataFrame.astype between string and object dtypes verifies copy-on-write memory sharing and isolation on mutation
test_astype_dict_dtypes: test DataFrame.astype with a dictionary of dtypes to selectively convert columns and verify copy-on-write per column
test_astype_different_datetime_resos: test DataFrame.astype between different datetime resolutions creates a copy and verifies no shared memory
test_astype_different_timezones: test DataFrame.astype between different timezones with same resolution shares memory via copy-on-write
test_astype_different_timezones_differen: test DataFrame.astype between different timezones and resolutions creates a copy with no shared memory
test_astype_arrow_timestamp: test DataFrame.astype from numpy datetime64 to pyarrow timestamp dtype with shared memory
test_convert_dtypes_infer_objects: test Series.convert_dtypes with all conversions disabled to verify copy-on-write memory sharing
test_convert_dtypes: test DataFrame.convert_dtypes to infer optimal dtypes and verify copy-on-write memory sharing for each column type
